sentences.en: A newborn heart rate of less than 100 bpm indicates the need for immediate resuscitation.

sentences.en: The average fetal heart rate is in the range of 110 to 160 beats per minute (bpm).

sentences.en: The monitor strip is considered to be reactive when the baby's heart rate elevates at least 15 bpm above the baseline heart rate for at least 15 seconds twice in a 20-minute period.

sentences.en: So if you're 30 years old then your maximum heart rate is 190 beats per minute (bpm).

sentences.en: If you're 30 years old and your maximum heart rate is 190 bpm, your target heart rate should be between 95 and 114 bpm if you're new to fitness, and between 114 and 133 bpm if you're an experienced exerciser.
